instruction: Center the title of this document.

parameters.window_name: The Wonders of Our Solar System.docx - LibreOffice Writer

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent explored File menu, Save Remote dialog, Manage services, and File > Send submenu to find collaboration options. Correctly identified that real-time collaborative editing is not supported in LibreOffice Writer desktop and declared the task infeasible.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Writer menus, explore File menu options, interact with dialogs, identify infeasible tasks
metadata.task_rationale: Since the model successfully navigated LibreOffice Writer menus, this variation tests a simple formatting task: centering the title paragraph. Requires selecting text and applying center alignment.
metadata.explanation: Task requires centering the first paragraph (title). Getter reads the docx file and checks the alignment property of the first paragraph. Metric returns 1.0 if alignment is CENTER.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the first paragraph (title) alignment from the docx file using python-docx WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER comparison
Metric correctly checks the is_centered boolean from the getter result and returns 1.0/0.0
Postconfig properly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before getter reads it, ensuring fresh state
Single instruction requirement (center the title) is fully covered by the evaluator
Error handling is present for missing files and empty documents
